description: Batch sizes of KernelBench level 2 problem 59 (Matmul_Swish_Scaling) at in_features = out_features = 32768. The original sweep was 32 to 512 rows; it is extended down to a single row so that the performance cases span 512x. Every batch reads the whole 4 GiB float32 weight, so even one row takes well over 10 us. Batches 3, 100 and 1000 are correctness-only boundary and partial-tile shapes.
